part3.hint: The vocabulary words are printed in bold.  ·  1 mark each
part3.story: Every summer, the final of our city's football cup is broadcast live on television. This year, the match was between the Eagles and their old rival, the Lions. People think the two teams hate each other, but in fact there is mutual respect between them. From the first minute, the Lions were the dominant team. Their striker, Ali, ran with tremendous speed. In the second half, the ball bounced off the post, and Ali kicked it into the goal. The crowd burst into cheering. The Eagles' young goalkeeper, Sami, felt ashamed because he had let in two goals. His captain patted him on the shoulder to console him. “Don't be sad,” he said. “Next year we will restore our name.” After the match, the gold cup was nowhere to be found. Everyone searched for an hour. Finally, a worker found it underneath a seat, and the Lions lifted their cup at last.

Sami felt proud after the two goals went in.
Sami's captain tried to make him feel better.
The cup was found inside the changing room.
People stopped searching for the cup after five minutes.
